```python
def remove_zero_sum_pairs(s):
    """反复删除相邻且和为10的数字对。"""
    while True:
        new_s = s.replace('19', '').replace('91', '').replace('28', '').replace('82', '') \
                 .replace('37', '').replace('73', '').replace('46', '').replace('64', '') \
                 .replace('55', '').replace('77', '').replace('88', '').replace('99', '')
        if new_s == s:
            break
        s = new_s
    return s
```

```python
def stable_dedup(items):
    """去重并保留首次出现顺序。"""
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for x in items:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            out.append(x)
    return out
```
